title: Christmas Table Cloth
text: Christmas Table Cloth. I have finally determined that this is a Christmas tablecloth. I will keep it for that occasion. It is smaller than I expected as well. It just fits my 36 x 36 table with tiny overlap so the table in that picture must be tiny! I am not a huge fan of "sparkly" but also be aware that the edging is sparkly. It will look nice at the holidays. I was looking for red for any holiday.
